newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-CENTURIONS PUT N.TVL ON TOP VS GRIQUAS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CENTURIONS PUT N.TVL ON TOP VS GRIQUAS.

text.p: partnership between centurions Andre Seymore and Martin van
Jaarsveld put Northern Transvaal on top on the first day of
their Supersport Series match against Griqualand West in
The pair rescued their side from 87 for four after they had
been invited to bat, allowing Northerns to close on 278 for five
with opener Seymore still undefeated on a career best 127.
He scored only 18 runs between lunch and tea after racing to
his half-century in the morning session and by the close had
batted six and a half hours, facing 308 balls and striking 13
Van Jaarsveld by contrast raced to his maiden first class
century scoring 109 in only 177 balls hitting 17 fours and two
sixes before he was caught off the bowling of Garth Roe.
D.De Vos c Brookes b Walsh 8
